title: bayesreml: Bayesian mixed models with ASReml syntax
description: An R package for specifying mixed models in ASReml-style or brms-style formula syntax and estimating them via greta or INLA, with cross-engine posterior triangulation as the signature output. Variance components default to PC priors per Simpson, Rue, Riebler, Martins, and Sørbye (2017). Supports Gaussian, binomial, Poisson, negative binomial, gamma, and beta families; structured covariance (us, fa, ar1); genomic relationship matrices (GBLUP); pedigree-based models; spatial models; and splines.

creators.name: Moldovan, Max

references: Simpson, D., Rue, H., Riebler, A., Martins, T. G., & Sørbye, S. H. (2017). Penalising model component complexity: a principled, practical approach to constructing priors. Statistical Science, 32(1), 1–28.
